newsitem.title: USA: Linens says files for 5.25 mln shr secondary.
newsitem.headline: Linens says files for 5.25 mln shr secondary.

text.p: Linens 'n Things Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission covering a proposed public secondary offering of 5.25 million shares of its common stock.
The company said all shares will be sold by Nashua Hollis CVS Inc, a subsidiary of CVS Corp.
The company said Credit Suise First Boston will manage the underwriting syndicate for the proposed offering.
Linens 'n Things said it will not receive any proceeds from the proposed sale of shares of common stock by the selling shareholder.
